brief:
An Israeli drone strike killed a young Palestinian man and wounded several others in the Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza on Saturday evening, Middle East Eye reported. The strike was among multiple incidents across the enclave that day.

Six Palestinians were killed in the strikes overall, though additional details about the other incidents and casualties were not immediately available.

title: Israeli strikes kill six Palestinians across Gaza in single day
